program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (let loop ([remaining (filter-cells g (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 1))))] [out g])
      (if (empty? remaining)
          out
          (let* ((start (first remaining))
                 (region (connected-region g (first start) (second start)
                           (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 1))) 4))
                 (colors (remove-duplicates
                           (filter (lambda (v) (> v 1))
                                   (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) region))))
                 (next-remaining (filter (lambda (p) (not (member? p region))) remaining)))
            (if (= (length colors) 1)
                (loop next-remaining
                      (for/fold ([acc out]) ([p (in-list region)])
                        (if (= (at acc (first p) (second p)) 0)
                            (set-cell acc (first p) (second p) (first colors))
                            acc)))
                (loop next-remaining out)))))))
